description: Mark one or more Gmail messages as read by removing the UNREAD label. With add_labels or remove_labels given, it applies exactly those and nothing else, so add_labels alone does not mark anything read and add_labels ["UNREAD"] marks unread. Pass message_id for a single message (returns the modified message) or message_ids for a batch (up to 1000, single API call via users.messages.batchModify).

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

message_id.description: A single Gmail message ID to modify. Provide either this or message_ids.

message_ids.description: Multiple Gmail message IDs to modify in one batch call (max 1000). Provide either this or message_id.

remove_labels.description: Label IDs to remove (e.g., ["UNREAD", "INBOX"]). Defaults to ["UNREAD"] if neither add_labels nor remove_labels is provided.

name: gws-mcp__gmail_mark_read
